fact: The ministries of civil registration and social protection signed an agreement integrating the National Population Registration System with the social protection system to verify existence and live status of persons.
Namibia's Chief Registrar said all applicants for the Covid-19 Emergency Income Grant were verified against the NPRS, and social protection verifies live status against it.
The Ministry says its mandate is to manage the National Population Register and that the National Population Registration System (NPRS, e-NPRS) holds ID application records and verifies them.
The Ministry says the e-birth notification system electronically notifies the e-NPRS of a birth and captures the child's birth details, and deaths are notified electronically in line with births.
The Ministry says the e-birth notification system verifies the mother's identity against the NPRS.

Deputy Minister Lucia Witbooi said births and deaths from 135 connected health facilities are notified electronically, promoting accuracy of the data captured on the National Population Registration System (NPRS).
